notes.title: Barzakh: Star Gardener - First Playtest Now Live!
notes.notes: [p]Hello, cosmic explorers![/p][p]We’re thrilled to announce that the first [i]Barzakh: Star Gardener[/i] playtest is now available on Steam! This early build offers a 10-minute glimpse into the core player control systems and fundamental mechanics, setting the stage for our surreal, star-hunting adventure. You’ll also get a taste of the game’s unique environment and atmosphere, inspired by the journey to find hidden stars across mystical universes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45684387/f205c8140ed455c3dc08e4fb21791db09a82c757.png"][/img][/p][h2]What’s in the Playtest?[/h2][list][*][p][b]Core Systems[/b]: Experience the foundational movement, inventory, and puzzle mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Charon’s Introduction[/b]: Meet Charon in their animation-free form, a work-in-progress glimpse of our protagonist.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Airplane Sequence[/b]: Test a thrilling 1-minute airplane piloting segment, crafted with weeks of dedication.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Atmospheric Preview[/b]: Immerse yourself in the early environment that sets the tone for [i]Barzakh[/i].[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45684387/6e58287febe16200684b671ca9e42478ba69829e.png"][/img][/p][h2]What to Expect[/h2][p]This playtest is a compact 10-minute experience, showcasing the groundwork before our full demo. There’s no further progression after the 10-minute mark, so no need to push beyond—it’s all about getting a feel for the core gameplay![/p][p][/p][h2]Our Vision[/h2][p]In the full game, we plan to weave in diverse systems like shooting, enemy evasion, farming, and horseback riding, spread across a longer, richer experience. The airplane sequence is just one example of the unique, bite-sized mechanics we’re integrating to keep every moment fresh and engaging.[/p][p][/p][h2]Feedback Wanted![/h2][p]This playtest is our first step, and your thoughts are invaluable. Jump in, explore, and let us know how the gameplay feels on Steam discussions or our community channels. Your feedback will shape [i]Barzakh[/i]’s journey![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for joining us in these early stars. Stay tuned for more updates![/p]

notes.title: Announcement: Process Planning!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello [b]Barzakh[/b] community,[/p][p]I am [i]Emirhan Güngörmez[/i] from [i]Han Interactive Entertainment[/i] and the creator of [i]Barzakh: The Star Gardener[/i]. With a small but passionate team, I am thrilled to announce that [i]Barzakh[/i] is now live on Steam! Inspired by the poetic spirit of [i]The Little Prince[/i] and Sufi mysticism, this game tells the spiritual journey of pilot Emir following a plane crash in the desert. Today, I’d like to share our plans leading up to the Steam Next Fest in October and the unique world of [i]Barzakh[/i], particularly how the deep meanings of the Arabic language breathe life into it.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45684387/35984a350c013b65ab4ac7ce9a2b2f260cdf3f3c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]The Path to Next Fest: Our Plans[/h2][p]The Steam Next Fest in October is a turning point for us. During this time, we are planning three playtests to shape [i]Barzakh[/i] together with you. Your feedback will play a key role in perfecting the game’s soul and mechanics.[/p][list][*][p][b]First Playtest[/b]: Focused on an initial experience with a short task. We will test the core mechanics and seek to understand how the story and atmosphere feel to you. Your feedback will strengthen the game’s foundation.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Second Playtest[/b]: Aiming for improvements in gameplay and visual effects. We will work to make puzzles more fluid and intuitive, deepening your experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Third Playtest[/b]: Scheduled just before the Next Fest demo. This will be the final rehearsal to finalize the demo, with every detail carefully crafted to immerse you in the experience.[/p][/*][/list][p]At Next Fest, we will present a 30-35 minute demo. This demo will reflect [i]Barzakh[/i]’s essence: short, impactful, and memorable. Our first demo is incredibly important to us; it’s not just for players but also an opportunity to connect with publishers and investors. The impact we create at Next Fest will shape [i]Barzakh[/i]’s future. We are already prepared to receive feedback from interested publishers, and your support empowers us on this journey.[/p][p][/p][h2]The Unique World of Barzakh and the Deep Meaning of Arabic[/h2][p][i]Barzakh: The Star Gardener[/i] is more than a game—it’s a journey of discovery and inner transformation. The term “Barzakh,” derived from Arabic, refers to the invisible veil between worldly life and the afterlife—a space of transition, seeking, and transformation. This concept forms the foundation of Emir’s spiritual journey born from desert solitude. The deep, multi-layered meanings of Arabic are woven into the game’s essence. Each universe is rooted in a word, drawn from Arabic’s poetic and philosophical richness. For instance, a star might point to a word like “patience,” “journey,” or “discovery,” inviting players to reflect.[/p][p]The game’s most captivating aspect lies in its metaphysical natural events, breathtaking landscapes, and profound philosophical dialogues. Emir’s quest to collect stars across different universes is enriched by the imagery evoked by Arabic words. The puzzles in these worlds require not just logic but also a union of heart and mind. Diverse environments, minimalist yet striking landscapes, and carefully selected music make [i]Barzakh[/i] unforgettable. The neon-colored scribbles in the UI, inspired by modern interpretations of Arabic calligraphy, add a unique aesthetic without disrupting the atmosphere.[/p][p]As a small indie studio, we may not compete with top-tier indie games in animations. However, we believe our story, atmosphere, and the philosophical depth inspired by Arabic will set us apart. Every scene and word invites you to question the universe’s mysteries and seek your own truth.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45684387/31d7ca631addb0ebfe54245f7b08dc38aa18f74f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Barzakh’s Future: A Series Vision[/h2][p]We envision [i]Barzakh[/i] as a series. The first game focuses on storytelling and a lasting experience. The magical words of Arabic, diverse environments, stunning landscapes, and music will draw you into this world. You might notice limitations in the physics systems; this is an area we plan to prioritize in the second game. If Next Fest goes well, we could bring these improvements to the first game as well. Smoother physical interactions and enhanced mechanics await you in the series’ future.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="dhsVbxH0BX4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]We Await You[/h2][p]Add [i]Barzakh: The Star Gardener[/i] to your Steam wishlist: [url="https://s.team/a/3849950"]s.team/a/3849950[/url]. Join our Discord community, get involved in the development process, and share your ideas: [url="https://discord.gg/eea2st72tj"]discord.gg/eea2st72tj[/url]. Be among the first 1,000 playtest players to experience the game as a pioneer.[/p][p][/p][p]As a small studio, your support means everything to us. [i]Barzakh[/i] is not just a game but a dream and a quest for truth. We eagerly await to turn this journey, steeped in the deep meanings of Arabic, into reality with you at Next Fest.[/p][p][/p][p]Let us meet under the stars of truth,
Emirhan Güngörmez
Han Interactive Entertainment
